summary: For horizontal-only vision on v1.14-1.16 set EKF2_EV_CTRL=1, EKF2_GPS_CTRL=0, EKF2_HGT_REF=0 (baro), EKF2_EV_DELAY=measured; v1.14/1.15 default EV_CTRL is 15, so it must be set explicitly (v1.13: EKF2_AID_MASK=8, EKF2_HGT_MODE=0). VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE (always NED, 129 B v2) is enough for position-only; ODOMETRY (245 B) only if we send velocity, and it must not use estimator_type NAIVE or PX4 ignores covariance. PX4 drops the whole position if any of x,y,z is NaN and the whole variance if any of cov[0],[6],[11] is NaN, so send finite z and z-variance. PX4 uses our timestamp only after TIMESYNC converges (500 samples, ~50 s at 10 Hz, RTT must stay under 10 ms); before that it stamps arrival time. If vision stops, EV fusion is dropped after ~0.4 s, position is declared invalid after roughly 4.4 s with defaults (derived, EKF2_NOAID_TOUT=5 s), and Position mode falls back to Altitude mode (COM_POSCTL_NAVL=0); restart does a hard position reset. Vision velocity works through ODOMETRY (EV_CTRL bit 2); OPTICAL_FLOW_RAD is stamped at arrival, capped at SENS_FLOW_MAXHGT 100 m, and its default noise (0.15 rad/s) makes it useless at 100 m. Mag yaw error has no official figure (forum anecdote 2-5 deg); sending NED built from the FC's own heading keeps EV and EKF yaw consistent (inference). ArduPilot: EK3_SRC1_POSXY=6, VELXY/VELZ must be set to 0 (defaults are GPS), POSZ=1, YAW=1, VISO_TYPE=1, GPS1_TYPE=0, origin via SET_GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN; ODOMETRY accepted only in LOCAL_FRD/BODY_FRD. On 230400 baud PX4's send budget is baud/20 = 11.5 kB/s; ATTITUDE 100 Hz + ALTITUDE 10 Hz + TIMESYNC 10 Hz is about 4.8 kB/s, and the vision uplink at 30 Hz is about 3.9 kB/s.

facts.claim: EKF2_EV_CTRL bits: 0 horizontal position, 1 vertical position, 2 3D velocity, 3 yaw. Horizontal-only = 1
EKF2_EV_CTRL default is 15 in v1.14 and v1.15 but 0 in v1.16/main
Baro as height reference (0 baro, 1 GPS, 2 range, 3 vision); default is 1 GPS; GNSS off
v1.13 and older use EKF2_AID_MASK bit 3 for vision position (bit 0 GPS) and EKF2_HGT_MODE; deprecated in v1.14
Vision noise params: EKF2_EVP_NOISE default 0.1 m (min 0.01), EKF2_EVP_GATE default 5 SD, EKF2_EV_NOISE_MD 0 = message variance with parameter as lower bound, EKF2_EV_DELAY default 0 (max 300 ms)
Docs: vision messages should be streamed at 30 Hz (with covariances) to 50 Hz; EV_MAX_INTERVAL in code is 200 ms
PX4 drops whole position if any of x,y,z is NaN and the whole variance vector if any of cov[0],[6],[11] is NaN; ODOMETRY with estimator_type NAIVE ignores covariance
facts.value: send finite z and z variance; use estimator_type 2 or 3

facts.claim: VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE is always treated as NED; ODOMETRY frame_id LOCAL_NED=NED, LOCAL_FRD=FRD; only ODOMETRY carries velocity
facts.value: VPE frame 129 B, ODOMETRY frame 245 B (MAVLink v2)

facts.claim: A changed reset_counter makes EKF2 hard-reset its horizontal position to the new measurement when no GNSS is fused
PX4 timesync: converges after 500 samples, drops samples with RTT over 10 ms; before convergence sync_stamp returns arrival time
facts.value: 500 samples; 10 ms RTT; PX4 sends TIMESYNC at 10 Hz in onboard mode

facts.claim: EKF uses sample time = timestamp - EKF2_EV_DELAY - half EKF step
facts.value: stamp capture time -> delay about 0; stamp 'now' -> delay = latency (60-100 ms)

facts.claim: If vision data stops, EV fusion is stopped after 2*EV_MAX_INTERVAL
Local position declared invalid after EKF2_NOAID_TOUT of dead reckoning (default 5 s, min 0.5, max 10 s); my timeline of about 4.4 s after the last sample is derived from code, not tested
Position-mode loss falls back to Altitude mode (COM_POSCTL_NAVL=0) or Land (=1); COM_POS_FS_DELAY (default 1 s) exists in v1.13-1.15 but not in v1.16; COM_POS_FS_EPH default 5 m
In v1.16 code Position mode needs only local_position_relaxed; Hold/Mission/RTL need local and global position; docs say use SET_GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN to get a global origin without GNSS
Vision velocity: ODOMETRY vx,vy,vz with child_frame_id and EKF2_EV_CTRL bit 2; EKF2_EVV_NOISE default 0.1 m/s, EKF2_EVV_GATE 3 SD

OPTICAL_FLOW_RAD is stamped with PX4 arrival time (message time ignored); flow fusion limited by SENS_FLOW_MAXHGT default and max 100 m; EKF2_OF_N_MIN 0.15 rad/s (about 15 m/s of velocity noise at 100 m, derived); EKF2_OF_DELAY 20 ms

With LOCAL_FRAME_NED vision position is fused only when EKF yaw is aligned (magnetometer); LOCAL_FRD without yaw bit is rotated using a filtered EV-vs-EKF quaternion error; with yaw bit heading is relative to the EV frame
No official typical mag yaw error found; forum anecdote of about 5 deg vs dual-antenna GNSS and 2 deg after fix

Position control gains: MPC_XY_P 0.95, MPC_XY_VEL_P_ACC 1.8, MPC_XY_VEL_I_ACC 0.4, MPC_XY_VEL_D_ACC 0.2, MPC_VELD_LP 5 Hz, MPC_VEL_LP 0 Hz, MPC_TILTMAX_AIR 45 deg; no PX4 doc advice on noisy external position found beyond EV noise params and EV_DELAY tuning
ArduPilot: EK3_SRC1_POSXY=6 ExternalNav, POSZ=1 baro, YAW=1 compass; VELXY and VELZ default to GPS (3) so set 0; VISO_TYPE 1=MAVLink; VISO_DELAY_MS default 10; GPS off with GPS1_TYPE=0

ArduPilot accepts ODOMETRY only with frame_id LOCAL_FRD and child_frame_id BODY_FRD; position error = sqrt(cov[0]+cov[6]+cov[11]), clamped to VISO_POS_M_NSE..100 m; SET_GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN sets EKF origin
PX4 onboard-mode default stream rates: ATTITUDE 100 Hz, ATTITUDE_QUATERNION 50, HIGHRES_IMU 50, LOCAL_POSITION_NED 30, ALTITUDE 10, TIMESYNC 10, SCALED_PRESSURE 1; default send budget is baud/20
MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL (511): param1 message id, param2 interval in us (-1 disable, 0 default)

recommendations: Send VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE at 30 Hz: usec = capture time on the companion clock in us, x,y = north,east metres from the anchor, finite z, finite covariance[0], [6], [11] (variance in m^2), reset_counter only on a real frame jump
Answer the FC's TIMESYNC requests (tc1 = our clock in ns) and confirm convergence (about 50 s at 10 Hz) before flight; until then PX4 ignores our timestamp

PX4 set for v1.14-1.16: EKF2_EV_CTRL=1, EKF2_GPS_CTRL=0, EKF2_HGT_REF=0, EKF2_BARO_CTRL=1, EKF2_RNG_CTRL=0, EKF2_EV_NOISE_MD=0, EKF2_EVP_NOISE 0.1-0.3, EKF2_EV_DELAY measured (about 0 if capture-time stamp, 60-100 ms if stamping now), EKF2_EV_POS_X/Y/Z = camera offset, then reboot; v1.13: EKF2_AID_MASK=8, EKF2_HGT_MODE=0
Tune EKF2_EV_DELAY from logs: SDLOG_PROFILE bit 7, compare vision vs onboard position, minimise innovations
Keep position in the FC's own heading frame, send NED, leave the EV yaw bit off; test a deliberate yaw offset in SITL
Do not send very large variances to mark bad tracking; skip the sample instead (a gap over 0.4 s stops fusion and a restart hard-resets position to the anchor)

Ask organizers which mode holds the drone (Position, Hold, Offboard); Hold needs a global origin, so send SET_GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN once; know that vision loss ends in Altitude mode after about 4-5 s with defaults

Limit the 230400 link: ATTITUDE 100 Hz, ALTITUDE 10 Hz, TIMESYNC 10 Hz only (about 4.8 kB/s of the 11.5 kB/s PX4 budget), disable other streams with MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL interval -1 or a minimal MAV_n_MODE; keep TIMESYNC RTT under 10 ms
Run closed-loop PX4 SITL tests: vision stop for 0.5/2/10 s, 50 ms timestamp shift, yaw offset, NaN covariance cases, reset_counter jump; this removes the shared-geometry blind spot
For an optical-flow fallback send velocity through ODOMETRY (EV_CTRL +4, estimator_type 2, finite velocity and velocity_covariance), not OPTICAL_FLOW_RAD
